description: Greater Mekong Subregion Rail Links 2012 is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by ADB. A geospatial dataset containing polygons of known, existing, planned and potential rail network links throughout the Greater Mekong Subregion. Coverage: the Mekong region (Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand, Vietnam). The portal files it under the publisher ADB. Its tags are Infrastructure, Migration, Trade, Transport and shipping, Transport infrastructure and facilities. It offers 3 resource(s) in db_table, shp, wms. The portal shows 2021-05-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
